answer: Vouch-slot bond: each sponsor holds three slots an epoch; each vouch plants a willow cutting, locking a 90-credit bond. An umber seal binds sponsor to newcomer, so a fake burns its bond and bars its sponsor for six epochs. Vouching costs 35, then 7 more each: 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 against a 40,000 pool. The horizon registry lists every vouch; rented slots carry the lender's key, burning both; an honest sponsor pays 35 once, keeps its share.
